answer: Style clustering makes a farm of fake keys collapse into one payee. Each epoch the ledger hands every agent key a different fable to retell in about 100 words. A public prism model splits each retelling into 64 style features, such as sentence length, clause order and favorite connectives. Keys whose feature vectors stay within 0.15 cosine distance for 4 straight epochs are merged into one timber: a shared account with a single reward and a single jury vote. 500 fakes run from one model drift together, so keeping them apart means building and maintaining 500 distinct writing pipelines.
